cards.name: Lirilì Larilà
cards.caption: Time stops for no cactus
cards.flavor: 2025: an elephant-cactus in sandals who can freeze time with a little clock.
cards.art: Green cactus-bodied elephant with spines, big flappy ears and brown sandals, holding a small pocket clock. Background: desert sand and a big sun. Colors: cactus green, sandal brown, sand, gold.

cards.name: Trippi Troppi
cards.caption: Shrimp body. Cat brain.
cards.flavor: 2025: a cat's head on a shrimp's body. The brainrot ocean is a strange place.
cards.art: Coral-orange shrimp body with curled tail and little legs, topped with a grumpy tabby cat head with whiskers. Background: bubbly sea blue. Colors: coral orange, tabby brown, sea blue, white.

cards.name: Frigo Camelo
cards.caption: Cold drinks, warm humps
cards.flavor: 2025: a camel built into a refrigerator, stomping around in boots. Stay frosty.
cards.art: Tan camel whose body is a white fridge with a door handle, two humps on top, chunky boots, frosty mist puffing out. Background: desert dunes. Colors: tan, white, steel gray, sky blue.

cards.name: Rhino Toasterino
cards.caption: Breakfast is charging
cards.flavor: 2025: half rhino, half toaster, always about to pop. Do not insert fork.
cards.art: Gray rhino with a chrome toaster body, two slices of toast sticking out of slots on its back, steam from its horn. Background: kitchen yellow. Colors: rhino gray, chrome silver, toast brown, yellow.

cards.name: Bananita Dolphinita
cards.caption: Splash. Slip. Repeat.
cards.flavor: 2025: a dolphin wearing a banana peel like a wetsuit. Potassium-powered swimming.
cards.art: Blue-gray dolphin leaping, wrapped in an open yellow banana peel like a jacket, big friendly grin. Background: ocean waves. Colors: dolphin blue, banana yellow, teal, white.

cards.name: Burbaloni Loliloli
cards.caption: Coconut? Capybara? Yes.
cards.flavor: 2025: a chill capybara living inside a cracked coconut. Peak tropical brainrot.
cards.art: Brown capybara peeking out of a cracked coconut shell like a cozy hut, relaxed half-closed eyes. Background: beach with a palm tree. Colors: coconut brown, capybara tan, cream, turquoise.

cards.name: Cappuccino Assassino
cards.caption: Silent. Deadly. Foamy.
cards.flavor: 2025: a ninja cappuccino and Ballerina Cappuccina's heartbroken ex. He brews revenge.
cards.art: White cappuccino cup in a black ninja mask, foam swirl on top, holding two rounded cartoon blades crossed. Background: dark red with a crescent moon. Colors: white, coffee brown, black, red.

cards.name: Trenostruzzo 3000
cards.caption: Choo choo! Honk honk!
cards.flavor: 2025: an ostrich fused with a locomotive. Top speed: 3000. Brakes: unclear.
cards.art: Ostrich head and long neck on a chunky red steam locomotive body, wheels spinning, steam puffs, feathery tail. Background: railway and green hills. Colors: locomotive red, black, ostrich beige, sky blue.

cards.name: Chicleteira Bicicleta
cards.caption: Gumball on wheels, baby
cards.flavor: 2025: a bubblegum machine riding a bicycle, raining gumballs and confetti.
cards.art: Red-capped glass gumball machine full of colorful gumballs pedaling a little bicycle, gumballs bouncing out, confetti. Background: striped street. Colors: red, glass blue, rainbow gumballs, yellow.

cards.name: La Vacca Saturnita
cards.caption: Moo-ving in orbit
cards.flavor: 2025: a cow whose body is the planet Saturn, rings and all. Grazes on stardust.
cards.art: Black-and-white cow head and legs attached to a round tan planet body with a tilted golden ring, floating in space, chewing a star. Background: navy starfield. Colors: white/black, Saturn tan, ring gold, navy.

cards.name: Dragon Cannelloni
cards.caption: Al dente and on fire
cards.flavor: Steal a Brainrot's 2025 top-tier secret: a dragon made of pasta with blazing wings.
cards.art: Yellow dragon whose body segments are ribbed pasta tubes with ricotta ends, wings made of flame, smug smirk, a tomato-sauce drip. Background: dark red with ember sparks. Colors: pasta yellow, flame orange, sauce red, charcoal.

cards.name: Strawberry Elephant
cards.caption: Berry rare. Berry OG.
cards.flavor: Steal a Brainrot's OG legend: when this strawberry elephant spawns, the server goes pink.
cards.art: Pink elephant whose body is a giant strawberry with yellow seed dots, a leafy green crown on its head, trunk raised in triumph, glowing aura. Background: pink sparkles. Colors: strawberry pink-red, seed yellow, leaf green, white.
